visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair and white earrings stands outdoors at a market, holding a bright yellow can with a green base and top. She smiles warmly at the camera. In the background, there is a large white tent structure and blurry figures of people. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor market with many people walking between white tents. There are large green trees with yellowing leaves under an overcast sky. (3) Close-up of food stalls: a black food truck serves customers, followed by a wooden stand labeled 'BULLEN'S KORV' displaying canned goods and hot dogs. (4) Various close-ups of market items: wooden crates filled with red sausages, a table covered in decorative ceramics like gnomes, mushrooms, and pumpkins, and trays of dark chocolate balls and green sweets. (5) Inside a bright room, the woman holds a Shiseido foundation bottle and shows a screen capture of a beauty award. She applies the cream foundation to her face using her fingers and then blends it with a black makeup sponge. (6) Close-ups focus on her skin texture before and after application, highlighting the coverage of redness. She proceeds to apply concealer sticks to her under-eye area, nose, and chin, blending them out. (7) She applies setting powder with a white puff. The camera shows a split-screen or side-by-side comparison of the radiant versus matte finish on her skin. (8) The final scene returns to the outdoor market where she smiles, showcasing the longevity of the makeup look throughout the day.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar strumming with a light percussion beat sets an energetic and positive mood. There is no speech, just bright instrumental music for the first 11 seconds. (2) A female voice enters with a clear, friendly, and narrative tone. The music volume ducks slightly to accommodate the narration. Short 'Pop' and 'Ding' sound effects are synchronized with the appearance of text overlays and screen captures. (3) As the makeup application starts, the narrator's speech becomes more descriptive and instructional. Soft 'Whoosh' sounds accompany scene transitions. The music remains a consistent upbeat pop-acoustic bed throughout the process. (4) The audio concludes with a final enthusiastic testimonial from the narrator as the music swells slightly before a clean finish.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate and review Shiseido beauty products, specifically focusing on the glow foundation and concealer. The video combines an outdoor lifestyle vlog segment with a detailed indoor tutorial to show product effectiveness and longevity.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of Shiseido foundation, concealer, and powder with brand name mentioned and featured on screen.
